# Novel AI

> Novel AI is an AI story generator and book writer for iPhone and iPad, published by Bitmesh (bitmesh.ai). You say or type an idea and it writes a complete story with its own cover, then can turn it into a book with chapters, play it as an interactive story, or let you talk to its characters.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/novel-ai-ai-stories-generator/id6756558328
- Price: free to download with 20 creations a day (30 on the first day). Premium is $3.99 a week, $9.99 a month or $29.99 a year, with no free trial, and removes the daily limit.
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad, iOS 18 or later. 11 languages.
- No account. Stories, books and chats are stored on the device.

## Pages

- [Home](https://novelai.nowapps.cc/): what the app does: one spoken idea written into a story with its own cover, books of chapters, Play and Talk, the reader, and the Free and Premium plans
- [AI bedtime story generator](https://novelai.nowapps.cc/bedtime-story-generator.html): bedtime stories for kids from a child's idea, with age-group content rules
- [AI book writer](https://novelai.nowapps.cc/ai-book-writer.html): chapter plans, writing chapters, up to 25 chapters, PDF and EPUB export
- [Interactive story game](https://novelai.nowapps.cc/interactive-story-game.html): play a story as its hero with three choices a scene, and talk to characters
- [Contact](https://novelai.nowapps.cc/support.html): contact.appsnow@gmail.com
- [Privacy Policy](https://novelai.nowapps.cc/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Use](https://novelai.nowapps.cc/terms.html)
